title: Existence and uniqueness of a normalized derived comparison
statement: For additive functors F and G and exact horizontal functors x and y between abelian categories with chosen derived categories and K-injective resolutions, an ordinary isomorphism F followed by y to x followed by G induces a unique unit-normalized derived comparison isomorphism, provided G has invertible derived unit on x applied to every K-injective complex.

source.place: Tags 07A6 and 0D6E, normalized diagram direct image and derived composition.

proof.text: Apply derivedCoefficientComparison with the canonical right-derived units. These units satisfy the universal derived-functor property and are invertible on K-injectives. The acyclicity hypothesis supplies invertibility for the restricted target unit. Cancel the exact localization factorization isomorphisms to convert the universal-property equation into the displayed canonical normalization. Uniqueness is preserved by that conversion.

proof_origin.place: The ordinary and derived normalization parts of the parent proof.
